scripts.build:ext: bun run setup:vendor && esbuild background=extension/src/background/index.ts sidepanel=extension/src/sidepanel.ts welcome=extension/src/welcome.ts offscreen=extension/src/offscreen/voice.ts mic=extension/src/mic.ts camera=extension/src/camera/camera.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --outdir=extension/dist && esbuild content=extension/src/content/index.ts --bundle --alias:axe-core=axe-core/axe.min.js --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outdir=extension/dist
scripts.watch:ext: bun run setup:vendor && concurrently -r "esbuild background=extension/src/background/index.ts sidepanel=extension/src/sidepanel.ts welcome=extension/src/welcome.ts offscreen=extension/src/offscreen/voice.ts mic=extension/src/mic.ts camera=extension/src/camera/camera.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --outdir=extension/dist --watch" "esbuild content=extension/src/content/index.ts --bundle --alias:axe-core=axe-core/axe.min.js --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outdir=extension/dist --watch"
scripts.dev: bun run build:ext && concurrently -k -n server,ext "bun run server" "bun run watch:ext"
